headline: No API changes affect the bot this week, so today's ideas make leverage shrink after a loss and match it to each coin's normal noise.

ideas.title: Leverage ceiling that steps down after each loss
ideas.why: Studies of futures traders find individuals take more risk after morning losses to get back to even. Start the day at a 20× cap and halve it after each loss (20→10→5); /tilt and the report flag any trade above the cap. On 25 Oct you went the other way, up to 40×.

ideas.title: Liquidation vs noise check on each coin
ideas.why: Show each coin's 15m ATR as a % of price next to how far liquidation sits at 10×, 20× and 40×. At 40× liquidation is under 2.5% away, so on a coin whose normal 15m candle moves 1%, two ordinary candles can end the trade.

ideas.title: Require OI above its 20-hour average for Clean setups
ideas.why: The scanner already downloads 25 hours of open interest per coin. Requiring OI to sit above its 20h average, not just be up over 4h, would drop movers in thin, low-participation chop, a filter some 15m EMA + OI scripts use against fake-outs. No extra API calls.
